excerpt: One coding session. Two AI agents. Zero lost context. Run Claude Code and Codex CLI as a single paired session. - Bhavya6187/tandem
content_html:
One coding session. Two AI agents. Zero lost context.

Run Claude Code and OpenAI Codex CLI as a single paired session — each model in its own native harness. Work in either one, switch at any moment, and pick up exactly where you left off. No double spend: only one model runs per turn; the other stays in sync through pure local file translation.

uv tool install tandem-cli

Why tandem?

⏳ Hit a usage limit? Just keep going.

Claude runs out of its usage window mid-refactor? Type switch and Codex continues the same conversation a second later — same files, same history, same plan. Your two subscriptions become one long runway instead of two separate walls.

🌩️ Immune to outages.

An Anthropic or OpenAI outage doesn't stop your work. If the active model's API goes down, switch — the same session continues seamlessly in the other harness, and you can switch back whenever the outage clears.

💳 Subscriptions, not API bills.

tandem wraps the official CLIs under the auth you already have — your Claude and ChatGPT subscription logins work as-is. No API keys to provision, no per-token surprises. tandem itself makes zero network calls; every model call happens inside the real CLI, on your existing plan.

🧠 Two model families on one problem.

Claude and GPT have different strengths and different blind spots. Get a second opinion with full session context — no copy-pasting walls of text between terminals:

tandem run --on codex "second opinion: why is this test flaky?"

🏠 Every model in its native harness.

This is not a lowest-common-denominator wrapper UI. Claude runs in real Claude Code; GPT runs in real Codex CLI. Your keybindings, slash commands, MCP servers, and muscle memory all work exactly as they do today — tandem sits underneath, not in between.

⚡ Switching is instant.

While one agent is active, tandem quietly keeps the other one's native session file up to date by translating the transcript as it grows — pure local file I/O, no model calls, no "exporting…" step. The other side is always resume-ready.

🔒 Local, private, no lock-in.

Everything lives in the CLIs' own session files plus a small SQLite database in ~/.tandem. No cloud sync, no telemetry. Uninstall tandem tomorrow and both sessions still resume natively with claude --resume and codex resume.

Quick start

You'll need Python 3.11+ and the claude and codex CLIs on your PATH.

uv tool install tandem-cli   # or: pip install tandem-cli
cd your-project
tandem                       # fresh paired session; drops you into claude

Work normally. When you exit the agent, you land at tandem's prompt instead of your shell — that's where the magic lives:

tandem (claude)> switch      # continue instantly in codex
tandem (codex)> exit
to continue this session: tandem resume a1b2c3d4e5f6

Come back anytime:

tandem resume                # most recent session in this directory
tandem resume a1b2c3d4e5f6   # a specific one (id from the exit hint)

Command cheat sheet

Command What it does
tandem Start a fresh paired session (Claude active; --active codex to flip)
switch Flip active/shadow and enter the other agent — at the tandem prompt, or one-shot from your shell (one-shot only flips, it doesn't enter)
tandem resume [id] Continue the most recent (or a specific) session
tandem run --on codex "…" One-off prompt to the other agent, with full context
tandem status Show pairing, roles, and sync position

There are also three maintenance commands — tandem doctor (health check: verifies both sessions are resumable), tandem sync (manual catch-up translation), and tandem sync-mcp (share MCP server configs between the tools).

How it works

  • One model per command — always. Only the active harness's model is ever invoked (or, for run --on, the target's). The shadow side is pure local file I/O: tandem tails the active transcript, translates each entry, and appends it to the shadow's session file. The shadow's model is never called to "catch up".
  • A persistent prompt, not the OS shell. Leaving the harness lands you at tandem (claude)>. There, switch flips roles and drops you straight into the other tool, Enter re-enters the current one, and status / sync / doctor / run --on / sync-mcp all run against this session. exit (or Ctrl-D) returns to your shell and prints the resume hint. Every command also works one-shot from your shell, targeting the directory's most recently used session.
  • PTY passthrough. tandem launches the real CLI on a pty (raw mode, resize forwarding, signals through the line discipline) and never scrapes terminal output — the transcript files are the source of truth. Turn-complete hooks (claude --settings Stop hook, codex -c notify=[…]) are wired per-invocation as wake-up signals, with fs-watching as the data path and fallback. If your codex config already sets notify, tandem leaves it alone.
  • Append-only, crash-safe sync. Each transcript entry is translated as it lands — no bulk re-export at switch time. Appends are whole-line + fsync, and a write-ahead intent in the sync cursor makes translation exactly-once across crashes; on restart, sync resumes from the last confirmed entry.
  • Tool calls translate natively. The harnesses speak different tool vocabularies, so each completed call+result pair is re-expressed in the shadow's own terms — Bash ↔ exec_command, Edit/Write ↔ apply_patch, TodoWrite ↔ update_plan — and lands as a real tool-call record, so shadow history reads as the shadow's own work. Anything that wouldn't map truthfully passes through verbatim; a call whose result never arrived is closed with a (tool result not recorded) placeholder at handoff, since both replay APIs reject dangling calls.
  • Attribution stays legible. Every synced text message is tagged [via claude-code] / [via codex] (tandem's own notes use [tandem]), so interleaved histories make sense to you and to the models. Tool activity is untagged — it's mirrored as native records, not prose.
  • Errors are contained. An entry that fails translation becomes a single per-turn placeholder in the shadow, with the raw entry quarantined under ~/.tandem/quarantine/… — and sync continues. The shadow is never corrupted or truncated.
  • Memory files stay in step. Fresh launches and every switch sync CLAUDE.md ↔ AGENTS.md: shared content lives in a <!-- tandem:shared:begin/end --> block (newer file wins), tool-specific text outside the block is preserved, and a file without markers is read from but never rewritten. Git state is never touched.

Compatibility

Session formats are internal to the CLIs and drift between releases. tandem pins what it was built against (observed formats documented in docs/formats.md):

CLI Tested Accepted range
Claude Code 2.1.220 ≥ 2.0, < 3
Codex CLI 0.145.0 ≥ 0.140, < 0.150

Outside the range, tandem warns and asks you to run tandem doctor. Format knowledge is isolated per tool in src/tandem/harness/claude_code.py and src/tandem/harness/codex.py.

Where your data lives

  • ~/.tandem/state.db — SQLite: session pairing + per-source sync cursors (override the directory with TANDEM_HOME)
  • ~/.tandem/quarantine/<session>/ — raw entries that failed translation
  • ~/.claude/projects/<munged-cwd>/<session-id>.jsonl — claude transcript
  • ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-<ts>-<session-id>.jsonl — codex rollout (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / CODEX_HOME honored)

Claude session ids are minted by tandem (claude --session-id); codex mints its own on first run and tandem captures it from the new rollout file.

Extending tandem

The sync engine talks to a small adapter interface (tandem.converter.TraceConverter):

class TraceConverter(Protocol):
    def translate_entry(entry, direction, ctx) -> list[TargetEntry] | TranslationError

ReferenceConverter implements it via a normalized event model (tandem/events.py) derived from the observed formats. Pass your own converter to SyncEngine(store, session, source, converter=...).

Development

uv sync && uv run pytest
pipx install .        # or: uv tool install .

Dependencies are deliberately small: click (CLI), pydantic v2 (event schema), watchdog (transcript tailing), pexpect/ptyprocess (PTY passthrough); state is stdlib sqlite3.

License

MIT

sentences.zh: 还有三个维护命令 - tandem doctor（运行状况检查：验证两个会话是否可恢复）、tandemsync（手动赶上翻译）和 tandemsync-mcp（在工具之间共享 MCP 服务器配置）。

blocks.html_en: How it works

sentences.en: How it works
sentences.zh: 它是如何运作的

blocks.html_en: • One model per command — always. Only the active harness's model is ever invoked (or, for run --on, the target's). The shadow side is pure local file I/O: tandem tails the active transcript, translates each entry, and appends it to the shadow's session file. The shadow's model is never called to "catch up".

sentences.en: One model per command — always.
sentences.zh: 每个命令一个模型——始终如此。

sentences.en: Only the active harness's model is ever invoked (or, for run --on, the target's).
sentences.zh: 仅调用活动线束的模型（或者，对于 run --on，调用目标的模型）。

sentences.en: The shadow side is pure local file I/O: tandem tails the active transcript, translates each entry, and appends it to the shadow's session file.
sentences.zh: 影子端是纯本地文件 I/O：串联跟踪活动转录本，翻译每个条目，并将其附加到影子的会话文件中。

sentences.en: The shadow's model is never called to "catch up".
sentences.zh: 影子的模型从来没有被要求“赶上”。

blocks.html_en: • A persistent prompt, not the OS shell. Leaving the harness lands you at tandem (claude)>. There, switch flips roles and drops you straight into the other tool, Enter re-enters the current one, and status / sync / doctor / run --on / sync-mcp all run against this session. exit (or Ctrl-D) returns to your shell and prints the resume hint. Every command also works one-shot from your shell, targeting the directory's most recently used session.

sentences.en: A persistent prompt, not the OS shell.
sentences.zh: 持久提示符，而不是操作系统 shell。

sentences.en: Leaving the harness lands you at tandem (claude)>.
sentences.zh: 离开安全带你就会以串联方式着陆（克劳德）>。

sentences.en: There, switch flips roles and drops you straight into the other tool, Enter re-enters the current one, and status / sync / doctor / run --on / sync-mcp all run against this session.
sentences.zh: 在那里，switch 会翻转角色，让你直接进入另一个工具，按 Enter 键重新进入当前工具，并且 status /sync / doctor / run --on /sync-mcp 都针对此会话运行。

sentences.en: exit (or Ctrl-D) returns to your shell and prints the resume hint.
sentences.zh: exit（或 Ctrl-D）返回到 shell 并打印恢复提示。

sentences.en: Every command also works one-shot from your shell, targeting the directory's most recently used session.
sentences.zh: 每个命令也可以从 shell 一次性运行，目标是目录最近使用的会话。

blocks.html_en: • PTY passthrough. tandem launches the real CLI on a pty (raw mode, resize forwarding, signals through the line discipline) and never scrapes terminal output — the transcript files are the source of truth. Turn-complete hooks (claude --settings Stop hook, codex -c notify=[…]) are wired per-invocation as wake-up signals, with fs-watching as the data path and fallback. If your codex config already sets notify, tandem leaves it alone.

sentences.en: PTY passthrough.
sentences.zh: PTY 直通。

sentences.en: tandem launches the real CLI on a pty (raw mode, resize forwarding, signals through the line discipline) and never scrapes terminal output — the transcript files are the source of truth.
sentences.zh: tandem 在 pty 上启动真正的 CLI（原始模式、调整大小转发、通过线路规则发出信号）并且从不抓取终端输出 - 转录文件是事实的来源。

sentences.en: Turn-complete hooks (claude --settings Stop hook, codex -c notify=[…]) are wired per-invocation as wake-up signals, with fs-watching as the data path and fallback.
sentences.zh: 回合完成钩子（claude --settings Stop 钩子，codex -c notification=[…]）在每次调用时作为唤醒信号进行连接，并以 fs-watching 作为数据路径和回退。

sentences.en: If your codex config already sets notify, tandem leaves it alone.
sentences.zh: 如果您的 Codex 配置已经设置了通知，则 tandem 不会理会它。

blocks.html_en: • Append-only, crash-safe sync. Each transcript entry is translated as it lands — no bulk re-export at switch time. Appends are whole-line + fsync, and a write-ahead intent in the sync cursor makes translation exactly-once across crashes; on restart, sync resumes from the last confirmed entry.

sentences.en: Append-only, crash-safe sync.
sentences.zh: 仅附加、防崩溃同步。

sentences.en: Each transcript entry is translated as it lands — no bulk re-export at switch time.
sentences.zh: 每个转录条目在落地时都会被翻译——在切换时不会批量重新导出。

sentences.en: Appends are whole-line + fsync, and a write-ahead intent in the sync cursor makes translation exactly-once across crashes; on restart, sync resumes from the last confirmed entry.
sentences.zh: 追加是整行 + fsync，并且同步游标中的预写意图可以在崩溃时准确地进行一次翻译；重新启动时，同步将从上次确认的条目恢复。

blocks.html_en: • Tool calls translate natively. The harnesses speak different tool vocabularies, so each completed call+result pair is re-expressed in the shadow's own terms — Bash ↔ exec_command, Edit/Write ↔ apply_patch, TodoWrite ↔ update_plan — and lands as a real tool-call record, so shadow history reads as the shadow's own work. Anything that wouldn't map truthfully passes through verbatim; a call whose result never arrived is closed with a (tool result not recorded) placeholder at handoff, since both replay APIs reject dangling calls.

sentences.en: Tool calls translate natively.
sentences.zh: 工具调用本机翻译。

sentences.en: The harnesses speak different tool vocabularies, so each completed call+result pair is re-expressed in the shadow's own terms — Bash ↔ exec_command, Edit/Write ↔ apply_patch, TodoWrite ↔ update_plan — and lands as a real tool-call record, so shadow history reads as the shadow's own work.

sentences.en: Anything that wouldn't map truthfully passes through verbatim; a call whose result never arrived is closed with a (tool result not recorded) placeholder at handoff, since both replay APIs reject dangling calls.
sentences.zh: 任何无法真实映射的内容都会逐字通过；结果从未到达的调用在切换时会使用（未记录工具结果）占位符关闭，因为两个重播 API 都拒绝悬空调用。

blocks.html_en: • Attribution stays legible. Every synced text message is tagged [via claude-code] / [via codex] (tandem's own notes use [tandem]), so interleaved histories make sense to you and to the models. Tool activity is untagged — it's mirrored as native records, not prose.

sentences.zh: 归属保持清晰。

sentences.en: Every synced text message is tagged [via claude-code] / [via codex] (tandem's own notes use [tandem]), so interleaved histories make sense to you and to the models.

sentences.en: Tool activity is untagged — it's mirrored as native records, not prose.
sentences.zh: 工具活动没有标记——它被镜像为本地记录，而不是散文。

blocks.html_en: • Errors are contained. An entry that fails translation becomes a single per-turn placeholder in the shadow, with the raw entry quarantined under ~/.tandem/quarantine/… — and sync continues. The shadow is never corrupted or truncated.

sentences.en: Errors are contained.
sentences.zh: 包含错误。

sentences.en: An entry that fails translation becomes a single per-turn placeholder in the shadow, with the raw entry quarantined under ~/.tandem/quarantine/… — and sync continues.

sentences.en: The shadow is never corrupted or truncated.
sentences.zh: 阴影永远不会被损坏或截断。

blocks.html_en: • Memory files stay in step. Fresh launches and every switch sync CLAUDE.md ↔ AGENTS.md: shared content lives in a <!-- tandem:shared:begin/end --> block (newer file wins), tool-specific text outside the block is preserved, and a file without markers is read from but never rewritten. Git state is never touched.

content_html_zh:
一次编码会话。 两个人工智能代理。 零丢失上下文。

将 Claude Code 和 OpenAI Codex CLI 作为单个配对会话运行 — 每个模型都在其自己的本机工具中。 使用任一方法工作，随时切换，并从上次中断的地方继续。 无双花：每回合仅运行一个模型；另一个通过纯本地文件翻译保持同步。

uv tool install tandem-cli

为什么要串联？

⏳ 达到使用限制？ 继续吧。

克劳德在重构中用完了它的使用窗口？ 类型切换和 Codex 在一秒钟后继续相同的对话 - 相同的文件，相同的历史记录，相同的计划。 您的两个订阅成为一条长跑道，而不是两堵单独的墙。

🌩️ 不受中断影响。

Anthropic 或 OpenAI 中断不会停止您的工作。 如果活动模型的 API 出现故障，请切换 — 同一会话在另一个线束中无缝继续，并且只要中断清除，您就可以切换回来。

💳 订阅，而不是 API 账单。

tandem 将官方 CLI 包装在您已有的身份验证下 - 您的 Claude 和 ChatGPT 订阅登录按原样工作。 无需提供 API 密钥，也不会出现每个令牌的意外情况。 tandem 本身实现零网络调用；每个模型调用都发生在真实的 CLI 中，按照您现有的计划。

🧠 两个模型家庭解决一个问题。

克劳德和GPT有不同的优势，也有不同的盲点。 通过完整的会话上下文获取第二意见 - 无需在终端之间复制粘贴文本墙：

tandem run --on codex "second opinion: why is this test flaky?"

🏠 每个模型都有其原生的安全带。

这不是一个最小公分母包装 UI。 克劳德在真实的克劳德代码中运行； GPT 在真正的 Codex CLI 中运行。 您的按键绑定、斜线命令、MCP 服务器和肌肉记忆都与今天的工作方式完全一样 - 串联位于下方，而不是介于两者之间。

⚡ 切换是即时的。

当一个代理处于活动状态时，Tandem 通过在增长时翻译脚本，悄悄地使另一个代理的本机会话文件保持最新状态 — 纯本地文件 I/O，没有模型调用，没有“导出...” 步。 另一侧始终做好恢复准备。

🔒 本地、私密、无锁定。

所有内容都位于 CLI 自己的会话文件中，以及 ~/.tandem 中的小型 SQLite 数据库中。 没有云同步，没有遥测。 明天卸载 tandem，两个会话仍然可以通过 claude --resume 和 codexresume 以本机方式恢复。

快速启动

您的 PATH 上需要 Python 3.11+ 以及 claude 和 codex CLI。

uv tool install tandem-cli   # or: pip install tandem-cli
cd your-project
tandem                       # fresh paired session; drops you into claude

工作正常。 当你退出代理时，你会在 tandem 的提示符下着陆，而不是你的 shell——这就是魔法所在：

tandem (claude)> switch      # continue instantly in codex
tandem (codex)> exit
to continue this session: tandem resume a1b2c3d4e5f6

随时回来：

tandem resume                # most recent session in this directory
tandem resume a1b2c3d4e5f6   # a specific one (id from the exit hint)

命令备忘单

命令 它的作用
串联 开始一个新的配对会话（Claude active; --active codex to Flip）
转变 翻转活动/阴影并输入另一个代理 - 在串联提示下，或从 shell 中一次性（一次性仅翻转，不会进入）
串联简历[id] 继续最近的（或特定的）会话
串联运行——在法典“…”上 向另一位客服人员一次性提示，并提供完整的上下文
最后声明 显示配对、角色和同步位置

还有三个维护命令 - tandem doctor（运行状况检查：验证两个会话是否可恢复）、tandemsync（手动赶上翻译）和 tandemsync-mcp（在工具之间共享 MCP 服务器配置）。

它是如何运作的

  • 每个命令一个模型——始终如此。 仅调用活动线束的模型（或者，对于 run --on，调用目标的模型）。 影子端是纯本地文件 I/O：串联跟踪活动转录本，翻译每个条目，并将其附加到影子的会话文件中。 影子的模型从来没有被要求“赶上”。
  • 持久提示符，而不是操作系统 shell。 离开安全带你就会以串联方式着陆（克劳德）>。 在那里，switch 会翻转角色，让你直接进入另一个工具，按 Enter 键重新进入当前工具，并且 status /sync / doctor / run --on /sync-mcp 都针对此会话运行。 exit（或 Ctrl-D）返回到 shell 并打印恢复提示。 每个命令也可以从 shell 一次性运行，目标是目录最近使用的会话。
  • PTY 直通。 tandem 在 pty 上启动真正的 CLI（原始模式、调整大小转发、通过线路规则发出信号）并且从不抓取终端输出 - 转录文件是事实的来源。 回合完成钩子（claude --settings Stop 钩子，codex -c notification=[…]）在每次调用时作为唤醒信号进行连接，并以 fs-watching 作为数据路径和回退。 如果您的 Codex 配置已经设置了通知，则 tandem 不会理会它。
  • 仅附加、防崩溃同步。 每个转录条目在落地时都会被翻译——在切换时不会批量重新导出。 追加是整行 + fsync，并且同步游标中的预写意图可以在崩溃时准确地进行一次翻译；重新启动时，同步将从上次确认的条目恢复。
  • 工具调用本机翻译。 这些工具使用不同的工具词汇表，因此每个完成的调用+结果对都以影子自己的术语重新表达 - Bash ↔ exec_command、Edit/Write ↔ apply_patch、TodoWrite ↔ update_plan - 并作为真正的工具调用记录落地，因此影子历史记录读取为影子自己的工作。 任何无法真实映射的内容都会逐字通过；结果从未到达的调用在切换时会使用（未记录工具结果）占位符关闭，因为两个重播 API 都拒绝悬空调用。
  • 归属保持清晰。 每条同步的文本消息都被标记为 [via claude-code] / [via codex] （tandem 自己的注释使用 [tandem]），因此交错的历史记录对您和模型都有意义。 工具活动没有标记——它被镜像为本地记录，而不是散文。
  • 包含错误。 翻译失败的条目将成为阴影中的单个每轮占位符，原始条目被隔离在 ~/.tandem/quarantine/… 下 - 并且同步继续。 阴影永远不会被损坏或截断。
  • 内存文件保持同步。 新的启动和每次切换都同步 CLAUDE.md ↔ AGENTS.md：共享内容位于 <!-- tandem:shared:begin/end --> 块中（较新的文件获胜），保留块外的工具特定文本，并且读取没有标记的文件，但从不重写。 Git 状态从未被触及。

兼容性

会话格式是 CLI 的内部格式，并且在版本之间存在变化。 tandem 固定了它的构建对象（在 docs/formats.md 中记录了观察到的格式）：

CLI 已测试 接受范围
克劳德·科德 2.1.220 ≥ 2.0, < 3
法典 CLI 0.145.0 ≥ 0.140, < 0.150

超出范围时，tandem 会发出警告并要求你跑 tandem doctor。 格式知识在 src/tandem/harness/claude_code.py 和 src/tandem/harness/codex.py 中按工具隔离。

您的数据存放在哪里

  • ~/.tandem/state.db — SQLite：会话配对 + 每个源同步游标（使用 TANDEM_HOME 覆盖目录）
  • ~/.tandem/quarantine/<session>/ — 翻译失败的原始条目
  • ~/.claude/projects/<munged-cwd>/<session-id>.jsonl — 克劳德成绩单
  • ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-<ts>-<session-id>.jsonl — Codex 推出（CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / CODEX_HOME 荣幸）

Claude 会话 ID 由串联创建 (claude --session-id)； codex 在第一次运行时会生成自己的内容，tandem 从新的 rollout 文件中捕获它。

延伸串联

同步引擎与一个小型适配器接口（tandem.converter.TraceConverter）通信：

class TraceConverter(Protocol):
    def translate_entry(entry, direction, ctx) -> list[TargetEntry] | TranslationError

ReferenceConverter 通过从观察到的格式派生的标准化事件模型 (tandem/events.py) 来实现它。 将您自己的转换器传递给 SyncEngine(store、session、source、converter=...)。

发展

uv sync && uv run pytest
pipx install .        # or: uv tool install .

依赖性故意很小：click (CLI)、pydantic v2（事件模式）、watchdog（转录本拖尾）、pexpect/ptyprocess（PTY 直通）；状态是stdlib sqlite3。
